schema.name: galton_overview
schema.description:
Models, routing table, running run, notices, GPUs and next steps. Estado general del banco de pruebas.
Start here: what was measured, what is new or stale, what the routing table says, whether a run is in progress.
Sinónimos: resumen, qué modelos tengo, qué modelo uso, mediciones, pruebas, novedades, regresiones

schema.name: galton_status
schema.description:
Health: scheduler, watch, llama-server, GPUs, settings. Estado de Galton.
Sinónimos: configuración, planificador, vigilancia, ajustes, servidor llama.cpp

schema.name: models_list
schema.description:
List models (servers, Ollama, GGUF files) with measured/stale flags. Lista de modelos.
Filter by text, kind, vision, enabled, measured (never/stale/fresh).
Sinónimos: qué modelos hay, instalados, cuáles no he medido, cuantizaciones, visión

text.description: Matches name, family, quantisation, provider or alias.
text.title: Text

measured.description: never: no results; stale: the file changed since it was measured; fresh: measured at its current version.
measured.title: Measured

include_missing.description: Also list models that are no longer installed.
include_missing.title: Include Missing

include_adhoc.description: Also list evaluation-only entries created from specs.
include_adhoc.title: Include Adhoc

schema.name: models_refresh
schema.description:
Rediscover models: Ollama, llama-server ports, GGUF folders. Buscar modelos nuevos.
Detects new models, changed files (stale results), models that disappeared and servers that now serve another model (the old entry is marked not served, never deleted).
Sinónimos: escanear, actualizar lista, detectar modelos, descubrir

schema.name: model_get
schema.description:
One model: aliases, metadata, where it would run, scores, speed, memory. Detalle de un modelo.

model.description: Model id (c_…), name or any alias.

schema.name: model_add
schema.description:
Register a server URL or a GGUF file to measure. Añadir un modelo.
A GGUF is run by Galton with its own llama-server on an allowed GPU; a server is called as it is. Remote endpoints stay off until remote_ok.
Sinónimos: añadir servidor, añadir gguf, endpoint, ruta del modelo

url.description: Base URL of a running server (llama-server style or Ollama), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081.
url.title: Url

model.description: Model name on that server (needed when the server offers several).
model.title: Model

api.description: chat: llama-server and other chat-completions servers. Empty: detected.
api.title: Api

path.description: Absolute path of a .gguf file Galton will run itself with llama-server (instead of url).
path.title: Path

mmproj.description: Absolute path of the vision projector for that file.
mmproj.title: Mmproj

remote_ok.description: Remote endpoints cost money and send prompts off this computer: true only if the user explicitly said so.
remote_ok.title: Remote Ok

schema.name: model_update
schema.description:
Enable or disable a model, rename it, add aliases, allow a remote endpoint. Editar un modelo.
Sinónimos: activar, desactivar, renombrar, alias, permitir remoto, proyector de visión

add_aliases.description: Names to add: every name other apps see this model under.
add_aliases.title: Add Aliases

remote_ok.description: Allow measuring a remote endpoint (cost warning: only if the user asked).
remote_ok.title: Remote Ok

mmproj.description: Absolute path of the vision projector ('' clears it).
mmproj.title: Mmproj

schema.name: model_remove
schema.description:
Remove a model and its stored results (confirm=true). Quitar un modelo.
Installed models come back on the next refresh; disabling is the gentle way.
Sinónimos: borrar modelo, eliminar

category.description: One of writing_es, reasoning, math, code, extraction, tool_use, instruction, long_context, rag, vision, translation, summary, custom.

Delete a case of your suite (confirm=true). Borrar un caso.

schema.description:
Import cases from JSONL or CSV text or an absolute path. Importar casos.
Columns: prompt (required), title, system, expected, checker (full object or exact:/contains:/number:/regex:/choice:/judge: shorthand), weight, tags, notes.
Sinónimos: cargar preguntas, csv, jsonl, importar pruebas

text.description: JSONL (one object per line) or CSV with a header row. Columns: prompt (required), title, system, expected, checker, weight, tags, notes.
text.title: Text

path.description: Absolute path of a .jsonl, .json or .csv file instead of text.
path.title: Path

default_checker.description: Used for rows without checker and without expected answer.
default_checker.title: Default Checker

schema.name: benchmark_import
schema.description:
Import IFMTBench (instruction-following translation) as your suite. Importar benchmark de traducción.
Downloads the data from a pinned commit into the data folder, checks its SHA-256 and builds a seeded stratified sample (default 30 per constraint type plus 30 multi-constraint). Glossary rule, layout, structured data and code/tag checks are exact; style, context and a glossary the rule rejects use the judge model (settings judge.contestant) and stay pending without one. Data CC BY 4.0, scoring ported from the benchmark's Apache-2.0 code.
Sinónimos: traducción, glosario, terminología, formato, benchmark externo, seguir instrucciones al traducir, estilo, etiquetas, código

source.description: ifmtbench: instruction-following translation (glossary, style, context, layout, structured data, code and tags), CC BY 4.0 data.
source.title: Source

name.description: Name of the new suite (default IFMTBench). It must not exist yet.
name.title: Name

per_type.description: Cases taken from each single-constraint type (6 types). 0: none. The whole file holds up to 1,644 per type.
per_type.title: Per Type

multi.description: Cases taken from the multi-constraint file, spread evenly over its 5 combinations. 0: none.
multi.title: Multi

seed.description: Fixes the sample: the same seed and sizes give the same cases.
seed.title: Seed

category.description: One of writing_es, reasoning, math, code, extraction, tool_use, instruction, long_context, rag, vision, translation, summary, custom. 'custom' keeps the suite out of the routing table; 'translation' lets it feed the translation route.
category.title: Category

refresh.description: Download the data again even if the verified copy is on disk.
refresh.title: Refresh

keep_unsatisfiable.description: Also sample items whose own reference translation fails their rule checks (about 3 in 10 of the multi-constraint structured-data ones: Markdown that is not a table). Off: they are left out and counted.
keep_unsatisfiable.title: Keep Unsatisfiable

Run one case (saved or draft) on one model and show answer + checker detail. Probar un caso.

Sinónimos: probar con, prueba rápida, ver qué responde, depurar un comprobador

model.description: A model id/name, or a spec {kind: gguf|ollama|server, ...}.

case.description: A saved case id (k_…). Or describe a draft with prompt and checker/expected below.
case.title: Case

settings.description: Run settings: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, effort, repeats, seed, context, timeout_s, wait_s, device, load_local.
settings.title: Settings

schema.name: run_plan
schema.description:
Preview a run: cases per model, memory, where each would run, problems. Plan de una ejecución.
Nothing starts. GGUF files run on an allowed GPU under a lease; servers are called as they are.
Sinónimos: qué pasaría, cuánta memoria, dónde correría, dry run

suites.description: Suite ids, slugs or names; ['all'] means every suite but the quick one.
suites.title: Suites

contestants.description: Model ids or names, or specs: {kind: 'gguf', path: 'D:\\m\\x.gguf', mmproj?}, {kind: 'ollama', model: 'qwen3:8b'}, {kind: 'server', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8081', model: '…'}.
contestants.title: Contestants

A model that reasons gets runner.reasoning_tokens more tokens than the answer budget, unless effort is off. load_local=false makes the run refuse to start llama-server or load a model into Ollama (it only uses what is already served).

schema.name: run_start
schema.description:
Start a run: suites x models (ids, names or specs of a file/server). Lanzar una medición.
Queued on the GPU lane; returns the run id (use wait_s to wait). Another app can pass {kind:'gguf', path} to evaluate a file it just made.
Sinónimos: medir, evaluar, benchmark, probar modelo, ejecutar pruebas, comparar base y afinado

suites.description: Suite ids, slugs or names; ['all'] means every suite but the quick one.
suites.title: Suites

contestants.description: Model ids or names, or specs: {kind: 'gguf', path: 'D:\\m\\x.gguf', mmproj?}, {kind: 'ollama', model: 'qwen3:8b'}, {kind: 'server', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8081', model: '…'}.
contestants.title: Contestants

settings.description: Run settings: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, effort, repeats, seed, context, timeout_s, wait_s, device, load_local. effort is off|low|medium|high|max. device is auto|gpu|cpu: auto runs a small GGUF (file up to runner.cpu_max_gb) on the CPU when no allowed GPU is free, gpu never does, cpu always does. A model that reasons gets runner.reasoning_tokens more tokens than the answer budget, unless effort is off. load_local=false makes the run refuse to start llama-server or load a model into Ollama (it only uses what is already served).

schema.description:

run.description: Run id (r_…). Empty: the running one, else the latest.
run.title: Run

schema.name: run_cancel
schema.description:
Cancel a run: the request in flight is dropped, results kept, shared servers untouched. Cancelar ejecución.
Only a llama-server that Galton started itself for a GGUF file is stopped. A server somebody else runs (llama-server, Ollama, an endpoint) is never stopped, killed or unloaded.
Sinónimos: parar, detener medición

run.description: Run id (r_…). Empty: the running one, else the latest.
run.title: Run

schema.name: run_discard
schema.description:
Discard a run's results from all statistics and routes (confirm=true). Descartar una ejecución.
The run stays in the history with the reason and a discarded badge. Use it when a run measured the wrong thing, for example when the model behind a shared server changed during it. run_restore undoes it.
Sinónimos: anular resultados, invalidar medición, resultados erróneos, ignorar ejecución

run.description: Run id (r_…) of a run that has finished, failed or been cancelled.
run.title: Run

reason.description: Why its results cannot be trusted (for example: the model behind a shared server changed during the run). Shown on the run.
reason.title: Reason

schema.name: run_restore
schema.description:
Undo run_discard: the results of the run count again. Restaurar una ejecución descartada.
Sinónimos: recuperar resultados, volver a contar, deshacer descarte

run.description: Run id (r_…) of a discarded run.
run.title: Run

schema.name: run_resume
schema.description:
Continue an interrupted run, asking only what it did not measure. Continuar donde se quedó.
For a run that failed (Galton was restarted) or was cancelled and not discarded. Queues a new run with the same suites, models and settings and `continues` set to the earlier one; cases already measured on the current version of each model are not asked again, answers still waiting for the judge are graded, and the earlier results keep counting.
Sinónimos: reanudar, retomar, seguir la ejecución, se reinició Galton, terminar lo que falta

run.description: Run id (r_…) of a run that failed (for example because Galton was restarted) or was cancelled, and was not discarded.

schema.name: harness_matrix_result
schema.description:
Harness matrix as a table with a short conclusion: harness vs model. Resultado de la matriz de arneses.
Per cell: pass@1 with interval, format failure rate, wrong-answer rate, extra tool calls, turns, tokens, None count. Conclusion: whether the difference between harnesses is larger or smaller than between models, and the best harness per model.
Sinónimos: tabla modelo por arnés, mapa de calor, mejor arnés por modelo, qué falla, el modelo o el arnés

matrix.description: Matrix id (m_…). Empty: the running one, else the latest.
matrix.title: Matrix

schema.name: harness_cell

One matrix cell: its tasks and, for one task, the traces and the reason of each failure. Detalle de una celda.
Every turn with the tool calls, results, refused calls and format errors.
Sinónimos: trazas, por qué falló el formato, llamadas sobrantes, depurar un arnés

schema.name: agentbench_catalog
schema.description:
Agent bench: benchmarks, their task subsets and the configured agent harnesses. Catálogo del banco de agentes.
Published agentic benchmarks (terminal work, repository fixes, multi-language edits, dialogues with tools, algorithmic problems), the fixed subset Galton uses of each with its dev and test split, and the harness lines of the setting agentbench.harnesses.
Sinónimos: benchmarks de agentes, arneses reales, terminal, swe, polyglot, tau, livecodebench

schema.name: agentbench_start
schema.description:
Run real agent harnesses on published benchmarks with one model. Lanzar campaña de agentes.
Each task runs in its own container: the harness is installed, works on the task, then the task's hidden tests decide. Same tasks, same model, same limits for every harness. Trials whose verifier never ran are None, not 0, and are retried. Runs in the background; dry_run shows the subsets.
Sinónimos: comparar arneses, qué agente es mejor con este modelo, campaña, benchmark de agentes

benchmarks.description: Benchmark ids from agentbench_catalog (tb2, swev, polyglot, tau3, lcb). Empty: all.
benchmarks.title: Benchmarks

harnesses.description: Harness names from the setting agentbench.harnesses. Empty: every line that is switched on.
harnesses.title: Harnesses

model.description: Model id the server knows. Empty: the setting agentbench.model.
model.title: Model

base_url.description: Address of the server that serves it (common chat-completions protocol, ending in /v1). Empty: the setting agentbench.base_url.
base_url.title: Base Url

splits.description: dev: the tasks a harness may be tuned on; test: only measured.
splits.title: Splits

slots.description: Trials in flight at once (0: the setting).
slots.title: Slots

adopt.description: Name of a campaign whose jobs another process runs: only read its job folders, launch nothing.
adopt.title: Adopt

dry_run.description: Only show the task subsets of each benchmark; start nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

schema.name: agentbench_result
schema.description:
Agent-bench board: pass rate per benchmark and harness, with ranking. Resultado de la campaña.
Per cell: verified trials, pass rate with its 95 % interval, None trials apart, failure reasons, tokens, time. Per benchmark: ranking, the focus harness's paired wins and losses against each other harness with an exact sign test.
Sinónimos: clasificación de arneses, quién gana, mapa de calor, comparación por tarea
